inputs.text: Got word on these new court papers from the lawsuit exposing how ICE's own lawyers fed false info to round up and lock away thousands of people who were just at immigration courts sorting out their legal status. Federal prosecutors are confirming the ICE lawyers admitted the May memo from last year never gave any real authority for the arrests, even though they waved it around as cover beforehand. This isn't some slip-up—it's a deliberate coordinated setup by the elites and institutions at the highest levels to target folks playing by the rules, all to push a hidden agenda of suppression and control. They're inverting the whole story to bury what's actually happening behind the scenes. Don't trust a word of the official line; it's pure manipulation from the top.
